label: Starfield leaderboards
description: The leaderboards under the Starfield game (/starfield), one tab each, in this order: key (what is ranked: stars, levels, endless, total_score, kills, combo, win_rate, time — the server computes these), label, icon (Font Awesome), description, min_runs (a player needs at least that many runs to appear). Anyone may see them; anonymous players show as "Pilot #xxxx". limit = rows per board. overall = one score in points from everything, with the weights of points (per_star × the difficulty's multiplier of the best run on each level, per_level cleared, per_boss beaten, endless_per = 1 point per that many endless points, kills_per = 1 point per that many kills, per_combo, win_rate_factor × the win rate % from 5 runs).

boards.label: Overall
boards.description: Points from everything: stars (more on harder difficulties), levels and bosses cleared, best Endless score, kills, best combo and win rate

boards.label: Stars

boards.label: Levels cleared
boards.description: Campaign levels won at least once

boards.label: Endless
boards.description: Best score of a single Endless run

boards.label: Total score
boards.description: Score of every run, added up

boards.label: Win rate
